editorial.headline: Carnell Tate Announces Himself with Big Line vs. Baltimore
editorial.thread_title: [TEN] Carnell Tate Announces Himself with Big Line vs. Baltimore

evidence.feed_summary: Titans WR Carnell Tate racked up 145 yards on 9 catches in Sunday's loss to the Ravens. He more than doubled his nearest teammate in targets and catches and dominated the yardage. He drew 42.8% of Tennessee's targeted passes, snagged 45.0% of the receptions, and gobbled up 65.3% of the receiving yards. Unfortunately, Tate scored 0% of the TDs, because the lone scoring toss went to WR Wan'Dale Robinson. RB Tony Pollard scored the Titans' only other TD.

editorial.headline: Wan'Dale Robinson: Don't Be Fooled by TD; Wan'Dale Robinson Could Become Obsolete
editorial.thread_title: [TEN] Wan'Dale Robinson: Don't Be Fooled by TD; Wan'Dale Robinson Could Become Obsolete

evidence.feed_summary: If you had to start Titans WR Wan'Dale Robinson against the Ravens on Sunday, then he at least rewarded you by snagging the team's only passing TD. But don't give that play too much credit. Robinson totaled just 3 catches for 19 yards among 5 targets, and even the TD came on a (basically) garbage-time fourth-quarter play where he wasn't the first read. For the game, Carnell Tate dominated Robinson 12-5 in targets and accounted for 65% of the team's receiving yards.
